scripts.prestart:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess); if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force }"
scripts.start:clean: npm run prestart:clean ; npm run start
scripts.start:public: concurrently -k -n APP,TUNNEL -c green,cyan "node backend/server.js" "npm run tunnel"
